source: Skylit single-name universe maps (Trading Bot tradingview/_skylit/universe/2026-11-19), read-only
units: Skylit per-cell dealer gamma ('matrix' value): net dealer gamma for one strike and one expiry. Positive = dealers long gamma, negative = short gamma. The vendor does not publish the normalization; compare within a ticker only, never across tickers.
king_definition: largest |cell| within the strikes and expiries shown
excluded: No Unusual Whales data and no cached option-chain files of unclear source were read.
